fit.rule: Emily's ruling 2 (2026-10-21): the sealed Learn-then-Test rule unchanged (H0 null call rate >= 0.05, exact binomial, delta 0.10, fixed sequence from the top down) on an EXTENDED grid: t = 0.4999 down to 0.4901 in 0.0001 steps (p >= 0.9999 ... p >= 0.9901), then the sealed 0.49 down to 0.01 in 0.01 steps. t_S4 = the lowest t rejected before the first failure. If the top of the grid already fails, S4 fails honestly (t_S4 = 0.5) and the product shows the null call rate beside every confident call. The 5% is not loosened. Non-holdout cross-fitted predictions only, decided before any holdout read

model.design: Path 2 (Emily's decision 1): the GATED 10-split ensemble of the stack gate. For a holdout pair, z = mean over splits s = 0..9 of z_s(b over a), z_s = split s's frozen stacker (frozen_design of the stack gate's describe_decision) on split s's Gemma 4 31B LoRA scorer (the adapters of model.learner_rule) + split s's voyage-4 learner (+ one Opus describe per pair if describe is KEPT). p = sigmoid(z); arm scores = Bradley-Terry strengths of the within-test round robin of z. No fresh final adapter is scored
